name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-02-26, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
